brief:
Settlers attacked a cattle herd belonging to Palestinian residents in the northern Yarza gathering, east of Tubas in the northern occupied West Bank, on Tuesday, according to Shehab Wire. Residents intervened to prevent the theft, in what marks a fresh attempt by settlers to seize Palestinian property in the area.

The incident occurred as tensions remain high over settler encroachments on Palestinian land and resources across the occupied territory.

title: Palestinians repel settlers attempting to steal livestock east of Tubas
